items.name: 王浩全
items.note:
Unfortunately. this is the only version of PDF available for this paper (if you Google and find a better version, please let me know). Focus on the concept of "feature selection" and don't worry too much about the equations. This is still a fairly straightforward paper to read.

If you're interested in checking other materials about feature selection. Here is one general introduction to check
https://www.analyticsvidhya.com/blog/2016/12/introduction-to-feature-selection-methods-with-an-example-or-how-to-select-the-right-variables/

More information about feature selection can be found in ML textbooks and conference papers. But they may go beyond our current scope.

Prof. Hao-Chuan
